description.value:
You attune yourself to an underlying cosmic order to the world. While you remain in tune with this power, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks. If you critically fail any check while under the effects of this spell, the bonus ends and you instead have a -1 status penalty to all checks for the remaining duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Impeccable Flow]

Heightened (5th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (8th) The status bonus increases to +3.

Note: The automation for the critical failure effect defaults to 10 rounds and must be altered manually.

Your hand presses into your target, leaving an imprint on its body. The target takes @Damage[8[force]] damage with a Fortitude save. The first time within the next minute the target's Hit Points are restored by a healing effect, that healing is reduced by 8. After any amount of healing is reduced, the spell ends.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half the force damage and half the healing reduction.

Failure The target takes the full force damage and the full healing reduction.

Critical Failure The target takes double the damage and double the healing reduction.

Heightened (+1) The damage and healing reduction both increase by 4.

Infernal influence guides your words. For the duration, you have the Additional Lore feat for Legal Lore and gain a +1 status bonus to Deception and Intimidation checks, which increases to +2 against holy creatures.

Heightened (4th) Increase the duration to 1 hour.

Heightened (6th) Increase the duration to 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Infernal Supervision]

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

description.value:
You gradually merge several kinds of energy into your cupped hands before firing off a storm of bolts and beams that deal 4d4 force damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line. Creatures in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, they're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] for 1 round. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the area. If the line passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, inner radiance torrent attempts to counteract the darkness.

2 The line is 60 feet long.

3 The line is 120 feet long.

Two Rounds If you spend 3 actions casting the spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. The line is 120 feet long, the damage dealt by this spell increases by 4d4, and you enter a shining state for 1 minute, causing you to glow with light and deal @Damage[(max(2,@item.rank)-1)[force]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures that end their turn adjacent to you.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage, as well as the additional damage for the 2-round casting time, each increase by 2d4, and the damage to adjacent creatures dealt while in your shining state increases by 1.
